description: This file defines the CommandHandlerProvider class, which provides instances of NewCommandSourceHandler based on entity-action pairs, by scanning for beans annotated with CommandType and maintains a registry for command handling.

classes.name: CommandHandlerProvider
classes.description: Spring component that provides command handler beans based on entity and action annotations, initializing a registry on startup.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the registry of command handlers from beans annotated with CommandType.

methods.name: initializeHandlerRegistry
methods.description: Populates the registeredHandlers map with bean names associated with their CommandType annotation info.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Retrieves a specific command handler bean based on the provided entity and action, throwing an exception if none found.

methods.name: setApplicationContext
methods.description: Injects the Spring application context to access beans and annotations.
